description: JVM functions and direct calls slice (ISSUE-0093). JVM-only fixtures that run the real DEAL frontend (lexer → parser → name resolver → type checker) → real JvmBackend codegen → javac subprocess → java subprocess executing the emitted artifact (the harness fails a fixture whose codegen or JVM execution is bypassed). Covered forms: direct function calls, multiple parameters (mixed types), return values, nested calls, direct self-recursion (factorial and the double-self-call fibonacci, plus a side-effecting void recursion), left-to-right argument evaluation order with side effects (all-inline and hoisted/inline-mixed argument positions), parameter shadowing (a parameter shadowing a module field, a let shadowing a parameter that itself shadows a module field, and the triple-deep shadow chain field → parameter → body-top let → inner-block let — with and without the module field — where every binding gets a distinct emitted Java name so the artifact compiles under javac), and two frontend compile-error gates rejected before any backend runs (E3009 arity mismatch, E5001 argument-type mismatch).

tests.name: jvm-fn-direct-call
tests.description: A direct call to a module function passes the argument into the callee and observes its computed result
tests.source:
function greet(name: string): string { return "hi-" + name; }
export function test(): string { return greet("jvm-fn"); }

tests.name: jvm-fn-multiple-params
tests.description: Functions with multiple parameters of mixed types (int triple, boolean + string pair) are called with exact argument counts

tests.name: jvm-fn-return-values
tests.description: Return values flow through a call chain: each callee's returned value feeds the next computation (LuaJIT reference: double(21) * 2 = 84)

tests.name: jvm-fn-nested-calls
tests.description: Calls nested inside call arguments (callee of a callee, including argument sub-expressions of nested callees) evaluate innermost-first to 8

tests.name: jvm-fn-self-recursion-factorial
tests.description: Direct self-recursion: factorial calls itself until the base case, computing fact(6) = 720

tests.name: jvm-fn-self-recursion-fibonacci
tests.description: Direct self-recursion with two self-calls in one expression: fibonacci computes fib(10) = 55

tests.name: jvm-fn-void-recursion
tests.description: A null-returning function recurses directly on itself: the hoisted recursive call runs per level, printing 'step' once per activation (walk(2) → 3 steps)

tests.name: jvm-fn-arg-eval-order
tests.description: Arguments evaluate strictly left to right: each argument's observable side effect (a console.log before returning) runs before the next argument is evaluated, then the callee sees both results (12)

tests.name: jvm-fn-arg-eval-order-hoisted
tests.description: Left-to-right order holds when an inline side-effecting argument precedes a hoisted null-typed argument: 'arg-ran' prints before the hoisted 'hoisted-ran' (the inline call is materialized into a temporary ahead of the hoisted pre-statement), and the callee receives 7

tests.name: jvm-fn-param-shadow-module-field
tests.description: A parameter shadowing a module field: the body reads the parameter (5 → 6), the signature and the body use the same disambiguated Java name, and the module field keeps its own value

tests.name: jvm-fn-param-shadow-let
tests.description: A let shadowing a parameter that itself shadows a module field: the let's initializer binds to the parameter (LuaJIT's `local g = g + 10` reads the outer binding → 15), and the module field stays 1 → f(5) + g = 16

tests.name: jvm-fn-param-shadow-let-block
tests.description: Triple-deep shadow chain (module field → parameter → body-top let → inner-block let): every binding gets a distinct emitted Java name — the inner-block let never reuses the shadowed parameter's still-in-Java-scope name (JLS §6.4 forbids an inner block from redeclaring a method parameter), which javac used to reject after the CLI reported success — and the artifact compiles and runs to the LuaJIT value: f(5) = 15, + field g = 16

tests.name: jvm-fn-param-shadow-let-block-nofield
tests.description: Triple-deep shadow chain without any module field (parameter → body-top let → inner-block let): the inner-block let never reuses the parameter's plain emitted name (the same JLS §6.4 defect class — javac rejected `long g` in the inner block over the parameter `long g` after the CLI reported success); each binding gets a distinct name and the artifact computes f(5) = 15

tests.name: jvm-fn-frontend-arity-rejected
tests.description: A direct call with the wrong argument count is rejected by the frontend type checker (E3009) before any backend runs — codegen/javac/java never invoked
tests.source:
function f(a: int): int { return a; }
export function test(): int { return f(1, 2); }

tests.name: jvm-fn-frontend-argtype-rejected
tests.description: A direct call with a wrong argument type is rejected by the frontend type checker (E5001) before any backend runs — codegen/javac/java never invoked
tests.source:
function f(a: int): int { return a; }
export function test(): int { return f(1.5); }
